title: 4xB300 cross-framework (latest-vs-latest)
description: Cross-framework round on RunPod 4xB300 (x86 host): 16 cases, SGLang-Diffusion against vLLM-Omni, LightX2V, TRT-LLM VisualGen, ComfyUI and FastVideo. The sglang column is sglang main 1ab008f5b0 (2026-10-29) for every cell except FastH3 and the retired LTX-2 / LTX-2.3 rows; it replaces the per-cell preview trees of the first publish. Video cells come from the 2026-10-24 encode-aligned pass: every configurable framework encodes the MP4 like the closest competitor. LTX-2 and LTX-2.3 are retired after this round and keep their rows. Their successor LTX-2.5 is measured but held back: sglang main loads its Gemma-4-Unified text encoder through transformers, and the publish gate refuses non-native components.

hardware.machine: two RunPod 4xB300 boxes of the same spec: rx devbox b300r1022 for the 2026-10-22..24 passes (competitor columns, FastH3, LTX-2, LTX-2.3), and b300final for the 2026-10-29 sglang-main column plus the same-box competitor reruns listed under merge.replaced
hardware.gpus: 4x NVIDIA B300 SXM6 AC 275040 MiB, 1100 W cap (both boxes)

harness_commits.850052ac9: reruns b300img1022r / b300vid1022r (TRT-LLM H3 throughput after the multipart fix, LTX-2.3 vLLM-Omni)
harness_commits.bcb659a60: competitor fixes b300*1022s and the sglang preview-tree pass b300*1022p
harness_commits.f4bd198: sglang-main column b300fm1029 / fm1029 on b300final (harness unchanged from 6f80e3b apart from reports and docs)

frameworks.sglang: main 1ab008f5b0 (2026-10-29) for 13 of the 16 cases, measured on b300final with each case's selected B300 profile. FastH3: main 82f7249ce6 (matrix pass; not re-measured, by decision). LTX-2 and LTX-2.3 (retired, not re-measured): 3042cea843 = main 1e894eb92d + sgl-project/sglang#45965 #45977 #46045 #46046 #46047 #46099 #46100 #46101 #46102 #46105-#46111 #46145-#46149 (pass b300img1022p); all merged except #46100, which touches only the Qwen image cells. The first publish of this run (2026-10-29) used per-cell preview trees for every case; those inputs stay in raw/ and are replaced in the merge.

merge.rule: build_report_artifacts: a later input replaces an earlier one per (case_id, framework)

replaced.sglang (image cells, LTX-2, LTX-2.3): b300img1022p (preview tree 3042cea843) replaces the matrix pass (main 82f7249ce6), the r/s reruns and the main 02b98360 pass (b300*1022m, kept out of the merge).
replaced.sglang (video cells except FastH3): enc1024 sgl-stack replaces every earlier pass; its sgl-main and sgl-stack-before arms are A/B controls and stay out of the merge. Where an arm ran twice, the second round is published for every framework in the cell.
replaced.video competitors: enc1024 replaces vLLM-Omni (Wan2.2, Cosmos3 T2V/I2V, H3 x3), LightX2V (H3 x3), TRT-LLM (Wan2.2, Cosmos3 T2V) and ComfyUI (Wan2.2). TRT-LLM and LightX2V hard-code x264 medium/CRF 23, so their other video cells stand.
replaced.TRT-LLM MiniMax-H3: b300vid1022s (OMP_NUM_THREADS=8; FA4 for 4-GPU and ref2va) replaces the matrix pass: t2va 74.45 -> 69.60 s, 4-GPU 63.23 -> 37.79 s, ref2va 163.56 -> 106.92 s (the matrix ref2va ran masked SDPA after Ulysses padded an odd sequence).
replaced.LightX2V Qwen-Image-2.1, Wan2.2, Cosmos3: b300*1022s (torch_sdpa) replaces the matrix pass (Qwen 3.02 -> 2.56 s, Wan2.2 241.6 -> 100.3 s).
replaced.vLLM-Omni LTX-2 / LTX-2.3: b300img1022s (VAE patch parallel) replaces the matrix and r passes.
replaced.sglang (13 cases on main): b300fm1029 / fm1029 (main 1ab008f5b0, b300final) replace the preview-tree rows (3042cea843, e52f28491c, 4be217383f). Where a cell ran several interleaved rounds the last one is published for every framework in it: Wan2.2 round 3, Qwen Edit round 4, Qwen T2I, H3 T2VA and H3 Ref2VA round 2.
replaced.same-box competitor reruns: b300final, interleaved with the sglang-main arms: TRT-LLM Wan2.2 (93.905 s; was 94.382), vLLM-Omni Qwen T2I (2.347 s; was 2.372) and its throughput, Qwen Edit (2.840; was 2.862), H3 T2VA (69.017; was 69.268) and its throughput, H3 Ref2VA (106.154; was 106.367). Every other competitor row is from b300r1022.

merge.last_input: run_b300fm1029_ideogram4_t2i_1024_2gpu_tp_sglang_r1 is listed last so the run-level sglang version (taken from the last input) names main 1ab008f5b0, the tree behind 13 of the 16 sglang cells.

files.raw/: original runner output; exactly the merge inputs above
files.merged.json: merged artifact the Pages data was published from
files.issue.md: data-only tracker report with per-cell statuses and reasons

held_back.ltx2.5_twostage_t2v_2gpus: measured on b300final 2026-10-29 (sglang main 1ab008f5b0 5.113 / 5.101 s against vLLM-Omni 0da1d831 5.996 / 6.009 s, interleaved) but not published: sglang loads the Gemma-4-Unified text encoder through transformers.AutoModel ('doesn't have a customized version yet, using native version'), which the native-fallback gate refuses. Its result files are not in raw/; the cell is re-measured once sglang has a native encoder.
